query: SELECT version(), timezone(), getSetting('max_result_rows'), getSetting('max_rows_to_read'), getSetting('max_execution_time') FORMAT CSV

label: F00 server and limits
query: SELECT version() AS server_version, timezone() AS tz, getSetting('max_result_rows') AS max_result_rows, getSetting('max_rows_to_read') AS max_rows_to_read, getSetting('max_bytes_to_read') AS max_bytes_to_read, getSetting('max_execution_time') AS max_execution_time FORMAT CSVWithNames

label: F01 schema
query: SELECT name, engine, total_rows, sorting_key, primary_key, create_table_query FROM system.tables WHERE database = 'pypi' ORDER BY name FORMAT CSVWithNames

label: F02 month column
query: SELECT name, type FROM system.columns WHERE database='pypi' AND table IN ('pypi_downloads_per_month','pypi_downloads_per_day_by_version','pypi','pypi_downloads_per_day') ORDER BY table, position FORMAT CSVWithNames

label: F03 top projects August 2026
query: SELECT project, sum(count) AS downloads FROM pypi.pypi_downloads_per_month WHERE month = '2026-08-01' GROUP BY project ORDER BY downloads DESC, project LIMIT 80 FORMAT CSVWithNames

label: F04 coverage
